import { defineTable, col, rel } from "@rebasepro/server/schema";
import { country } from "./country";
import { address } from "./address";

export const city = defineTable("city", {
    columns: {
        cityId: col.serial().primaryKey(),
        city: col.text().notNull(),
        countryId: col.integer().notNull(),
        lastUpdate: col.timestamp({ withTimezone: true }).notNull().onCreateNow()
    },
    relations: {
        country: rel.belongsTo(() => country),
        address: rel.hasMany(() => address)
    },
    rls: "admin-only"
});
